```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(mapview)
library(leaflet)
```

```{r}

pickups <- read.csv("data/data-interns-export-2026-09-28-PICKUPS.xlsx - pickups.csv", skip = 11)

```

```{r}
pickups_2 <- pickups |>
  filter(Account.Name != "") |>
  select(name = Account.Name,
         route = Service.Resource..Name,
         street = Billing.Street,
         city = Billing.City,
         zip = Billing.Zip.Postal.Code,
         type = Organization.Type,
         subtype = Organization.Subtype,
         pounds = Actual.Poundage.Picked.Up) |>
  mutate(city = str_to_title(city))

head(pickups_2)
```

```{r}
pickup_sites <- pickups_2 |>
  filter(street != "") |>
  group_by(name, street, city, zip, type) |>
  summarise(total_pounds = sum(pounds),
            visits = n())

nrow(pickup_sites)
arrange(pickup_sites, desc(total_pounds))
```

```{r}
library(tidygeocoder)

pickup_sites <- pickup_sites |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(address = paste(street, city, "HI", zip)) |>
  geocode(address, method = "arcgis")

write.csv(pickup_sites, "data/pickup_sites_geocoded.csv", row.names = FALSE)

filter(pickup_sites, is.na(lat))
```

Not sure what to do after this lol

```{r}
library(leaflet)

leaflet() |>
  addProviderTiles("Esri.WorldStreetMap") |>
  addCircleMarkers(lng = pickup_sites$long,
                   lat = pickup_sites$lat,
                   radius = sqrt(pickup_sites$total_pounds) / 20 + 2,
                   color = "darkgreen",
                   stroke = FALSE,
                   fillOpacity = 0.6,
                   popup = paste0(pickup_sites$name, "<br>",
                                  pickup_sites$total_pounds, " lbs<br>",
                                  pickup_sites$visits, " visits"))
```

Findings: 12% of pickups were 0 poundage

summary(pickups_2$pounds)
